# Telia lanserar nytt sparpaket – Hacksaw vinstvarnar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (12 Oct 2026), with Swedbank chief strategist Mattias Isaksson and EFN analyst Ture Wester. The main themes are rising long rates and energy prices, set against strong macro data (PMIs) and earnings estimates turning up ahead of the Q3 report season. Company news covered Telia's new SEK 1bn savings programme, Hacksaw's profit warning (shares down ~29%) and Corem's Kista lease. Ture argued that Swedish medtech is oversold and undervalued, naming Getinge and Medcap, and noted a sentiment shift in forest stocks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ HACK — Hacksaw | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profit warning (no sequential growth in Q3), crowded retail holding, sector-wide iGaming weakness; shares fell ~29%.

#### Reasoning

Ture and the hosts expected a big drop given expectations and how widely the stock is held, and urged caution for those heavily in gaming. Ture called a 30% fall harsh, since revenue still grows 11-12% y/y and the miss is only ~2%. Unclear revenue sources and negative sector news add uncertainty. Near term the stock is under pressure, though the size of the drop may be an overreaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 shows sequential growth returning
- if the iGaming market climate improves

> *"Så kanske att man ska hålla lite koll om man äger mycket i gaming."*

---

### 🟢 GETI-B — Getinge | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Ture: Getinge underestimated and still cheap; medtech trades at a 30-40% discount with ~14% median earnings growth expected next year.

#### Reasoning

Swedish medtech has nearly halved over five years. Analysts expect all 10 of the largest Swedish medtech companies to grow sales this year, 9 of 10 to grow earnings, and the median result to rise ~14% next year. Valuations are 30-40% below historical levels. Ture singles out Getinge as underestimated despite its run since summer. Mattias agrees that growth plus valuation support make the sector interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if medtech earnings growth fails to materialise
- if the valuation re-rates without earnings delivery

> *"Jag tror att Getinge är ganska underskattat till exempel. De är lågt värderat fortfarande"*

---

### 🟢 MCAP — Medcap | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Ture: Medcap structurally oversold, hit by the general small-cap downturn.

#### Reasoning

Part of Ture's thesis that medtech is undervalued: the sector trades at a 30-40% discount despite earnings growth. He sees Medcap as oversold for small-cap reasons rather than company-specific ones.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the small-cap downturn deepens
- if earnings growth disappoints

> *"Även Medcap tror jag är en aktie som är så strukturellt nedsåld och drabbad av allmän småbolagsbaiss."*

---

### 🟠 SCA-B — SCA | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Ture sees a sentiment shift in forest stocks; SCA went from under SEK 100 to over 120 in a few months.

#### Reasoning

Forest stocks have done poorly for a long time. Target price changes and price action suggest sentiment may be turning, and Ture thinks a small turnaround may be coming.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the forest-sector sentiment shift reverses

> *"framförallt då SCA som har gått från under 100 till över 120 nu på några månader. Jag tror kanske att det kommer en liten vändning där."*

---

### 🟠 BILL — Billerud | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Best performer at the open (+2.7%) after target price changes; hosts see a forest-sector sentiment shift.

#### Reasoning

Several target price changes on forest companies today, plus Ture's sense of a sentiment turnaround after a long weak period.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the forest rally fades

> *"Det våras i skogen denna höst."*

---

### 🟠 CORE-B — Corem | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

A 10-year lease in the empty former Ericsson Kista complex helps vacancy; the stock is at a low but property stocks are hurt by rising rates.

#### Reasoning

The lease is clearly positive and the stock's rise is logical, per Mattias. But rising rates keep property stocks at year lows, Kista is a weak area, and Mattias fears a sector re-rating will take a while yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if long rates keep rising
- if Kista vacancies stay high

> *"Så nej, jag är lite rädd för att det kommer ta en stund till."*

---

### 🟡 TELIA — Telia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

New SEK 1bn savings programme in line with communicated strategy; Mattias says it confirms the line is held; shares up slightly.

#### Reasoning

The cost cuts continue the earlier programme. Inderes' analyst Joni Grönqvist calls it part of the communicated annual savings. Mattias reads it as confirmation of the strategy, but it also shows Telia has not reached its goals yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if savings fail to translate into margin improvement

> *"det är ändå en bekräftelse på att linjen vidhålls så att säga"*

---

### 🟡 ATRLJ-B — Atrium Ljungberg | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited analyst SB1 cut its target price to SEK 23 and kept a neutral rating after Friday's report.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (SB1), not the hosts' view: a neutral rating with a lower target price, against a weak property-sector backdrop of rising rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates continue rising

> *"De fick en sänkt riktkurs idag till 23 kronor, fortsatt neutral."*
